description: Generalize the proven Postgres review_jobs reliability model into a portable durable-job port and services/worker runtime while preserving Codecamp review behavior; bind handlers to capabilities only after the kernel is accepted.
deviation_notes: Task 1 was reopened by independent review on 2026-07-22 for build-context and coverage-evidence findings. Producer remediation and fresh independent re-review closed WKR-T1-H1 and WKR-T1-L1 with engine-level context proof, truthful combined coverage, quality gates, and exact-image runtime evidence. Parent-orchestrator acceptance completed Task 1. Task 2 established the current executable review_jobs baseline. Task 3 then fixed the compatibility boundary and accepted deliberate strengthenings: lease-token ownership, active-lease-safe enqueue/replay, replay audit, retryable webhook failure on enqueue loss, adapter-only DB access, and reversible generic-table adoption. No new live-Postgres claim or Task 4+ implementation is attributed to the design-only matrix; Tasks 4-5 remain pending.
